work.title: Triangle with Boxing Gloves
work.description: Mixed-media collage centers on a suspended red-and-orange triangle above two painted boxing gloves rendered in red and pink wash with ink linework. Scattered compact discs float across the white ground alongside a pencil-drawn snowman figure, a ruler, and chain fragments.
work.composition: suspended triangle above paired hanging gloves
work.dimensions_source: CD reference: 2 discs (top-right and bottom-left), measured directly at 260px and 250px native diameter, 4.0% spread. The description also names 'a ruler' elsewhere in this piece -- not used, per the art0469 lesson that machine-described rulers have proven unreliable without visible markings. Estimated 2026-08-03.
